$comment: What .github/workflows/soak.yml runs: each entry runs `suite` on every runner in `os`, in `jobs` fresh jobs per runner (default 1), each running the suite `repeat` times (default 1; e2e passes it to Playwright as --repeat-each). `args` are added to the suite's command.

Suites: unit, integration, chat-load, e2e, rust, windows-installer, windows-app, windows-direct, windows-quality, windows-obs, preflight, scripts, desktop-test, desktop-dmg, apt (see scripts/ci/soak-run.mjs for each command).

Edit this file on the branch, push, then add the `soak` label to the pull request (remove and add it again for another soak). Runners: GitHub Free runs 20 jobs at once, 5 of them macOS; the rest queue.

The entries below run every suite type 3 times: a quick check that each one runs and reports. To measure a failure rate, raise `repeat` or `jobs`: with N clean runs, the soak report gives a 95 % upper bound of about 3/N (rule of three), so 30 runs bound it below 10 %, 60 below 5 %.
